fact: UNDP says its satellite-based geospatial assessment found up to 174,100 hectares of Madagascar cropland flooded by the February 2026 cyclones, and it is working with national and local authorities combining satellite data with field verification to prioritise recovery.

UNICEF Madagascar says that with the EU Joint Research Centre and the Ministry of Water, Hygiene and Sanitation it has set up a drought monitoring system for southern Madagascar using satellite rainfall and vegetation data (CHIRPS, MODIS), while noting Madagascar has no national drought monitoring system.
